text: APPROVE: the extracted `ConvictedEntryKey` keeps the original guard conditions in the same order, returning null where the loop used `continue`, so behaviour is preserved, and the removed branches and lambda bring `ScanLines` under the threshold. The one thing I couldn't check is whether the unshown code after the guards uses `entry`, which is no longer in scope. I judged that unlikely, since the new helper returns `key`.
